source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = set()
            while stack:
                rr, cc = stack.pop()
                cells.add((rr, cc))
                for nr, nc in ((rr - 1, cc), (rr + 1, cc), (rr, cc - 1), (rr, cc + 1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and (nr, nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc] == color:
                        seen.add((nr, nc))
                        stack.append((nr, nc))
            objects.append((color, cells))

    positions = [cells for _, cells in objects]
    order = sorted(range(len(objects)), key=lambda i: max(c for r, c in positions[i]), reverse=True)
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for i in order:
            own = positions[i]
            shifted = {(r, c + 1) for r, c in own}
            if all(c < w for r, c in shifted) and not any(shifted & positions[j] for j in range(len(objects)) if j != i):
                positions[i] = shifted
                changed = True

    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for (color, _), cells in zip(objects, positions):
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
